title: Final Conclusion
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state that the solution is real and nondegenerate apart from a possible overall phase factor.

title: Contradiction Argument
description: Important Criteria: The response should include a logical argument showing that assuming the existence of a second solution leads to a contradiction.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The response must reference the boundary conditions that both solutions approach zero as x approaches infinity.

title: Integration Step
description: Important Criteria: The response should demonstrate the integration step that leads to the conclusion about the relationship between psi and phi.

title: Complex Conjugate Argument
description: Important Criteria: The response should mention the relationship between the wave function and its complex conjugate when V(x) is real.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of the equations relating psi and phi.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should not omit any constant factors when relating psi and phi.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The response could benefit from a clear explanation of the statistical interpretation of the wave function.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The response may include a discussion of limiting cases or examples to illustrate the argument.
